Definition: to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go down, descend; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go down, descend; 1a2) to descend, descend into (chastisement) (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to come down into, penetrate; 1c) (Piel) to cause to descend, press down, stretch (a bow); 1d) (Hiphil) to bring down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
